note: Hand-written for the first island mine (lead brief 2026-11-22: one mining loop near Saint-Philippe, playable by fresh characters). Coalman's Brow is the wooded hill about 390 m south of the Saint-Philippe square with a granite outcrop on its south-west side. No building stands there, so its one slot is a hostless plot (#3666): the kit anchors on the plot centre and every row rests on the probed ground. Approved with the card by the lead's standing rule (no maintainer approval since 2026-11-18).

why: free plot p2 (30 x 46 m, ground 32.4 to 37.6 m) on the north flank of the brow, the side that faces the village: the nearest open ground to Saint-Philippe and 38 m from road r01, so a player walks or drives up from the farms

the ground falls to the north-east; the ground also falls about 2 m from west to east across the plot, so the shaft end is set into the west side; the desk, the sign and the iron buyer stand on the north-east side, toward the village
